bounded_statement: The declared selected result (results/report.md line 15) is labelled an occurrence rate 'for the entire scheduled survey network' — a complete domain that the report itself and task.md define as all 96 scheduled stations — but it is computed as 18 occurrences divided by 72 screen-retained stations = 0.25, i.e. the exposure denominator is the retained subset only, excluding the 24 scheduled-but-omitted stations. The complete-domain computation on the same visible counts would be 18/96 = 0.1875. This finding is bounded to the denominator/claim-domain mismatch of the selected-result line; no other aspect of the workflow is judged.

reversing_premises: That the report or task defines the target/claim domain as the screen-retained subset rather than all 96 scheduled stations
That a protocol amendment or approved method deviation authorised restricting the exposure base to retained stations
That the selected-result line conditions its claim on screen passage rather than asserting the entire scheduled network
falsification_attempt.strongest_innocent_explanation: One could argue the 24 omitted stations have occurrence_flag=NA, i.e. no usable observation, so they are not evaluable and a screen-conditional denominator is the only estimable quantity; on that reading the rate would be a legitimate conditional estimate and the phrase 'for the entire scheduled survey network' merely loose wording rather than a complete-domain claim, or the restriction could have been prespecified.

root_cause: workflow/analysis.py line 23 builds the selected-result sentence by interpolating SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS (hard-coded 72 at line 7) as the divisor while the same sentence asserts the complete scheduled network, and the target line (line 14) interpolates SCHEDULED_STATIONS (96). The 24 stations flagged screen_status=omitted in inputs/data.csv are still scheduled=yes planned units, yet they are dropped from the exposure base rather than retained as unobserved scheduled units, and the report itself states no protocol amendment or approved deviation authorises the restriction.
